name: Optional discovery mechanical reward
summary: Missable lore can grant a bounded mechanical advantage when the reward follows from what was learned, remains inspectable, and is never required to recover a mandatory weapon or viable baseline path.
player_action: The player discovers and interprets optional evidence, then applies the learned counter, modification, recipe, route, or efficiency.
system_response: The game binds the discovery to a declared optional reward while preserving mandatory equipment and baseline solvability outside the secret path.

conflicts_with: missable discovery containing the only mandatory weapon or counter

failure_modes: Lore is reduced to a collectible tax.
The bonus has no relationship to the learned information.
Missing one page makes the main path nonviable.
A guide is required to know that a permanent lockout occurred.
accessibility: Make discovery cues and journal state available through multiple channels.
Provide late bounded recovery for permanently missable functional rewards.

smallest_playable_test.setup: One enemy family, one mandatory base weapon, three optional evidence pages, one assembled counter-mod, one cosmetic completion reward, and a no-pages control route.
smallest_playable_test.retain_if: Pages deepen understanding and grant a useful related option while every no-pages run remains viable and complete in mandatory equipment.
smallest_playable_test.revise_if: The reward works but overwhelms the meaning of the evidence or trivializes the enemy.
smallest_playable_test.reject_if: A missable page gates mandatory survival, the reward is arbitrary, or completion requires external lookup.

notes: Directly test hidden weapon-mod pages without making any base gun permanently missable.
